journal.hall_locked: **The Hall of Whispers** — a legend awaits those who master every path.

chronicler.sighting:
🕯️ *The air grows still. In the corner of your eye — a robed figure, standing where no one stood a breath ago. His face is shadow, his hands are ink-stained. He watches you. Then he is simply... gone.*

*A page drifts to the floor where he stood. In fresh ink:* "You have walked the paths and stood before the Vault Guardian. I am The Chronicler, scribe of the Journal — the pages remember you now."

A new name now waits in the NPC list: **The Chronicler** (`!npc`). He is the Journal's scribe — talk to him to learn what he guards.
chronicler.locked: You are not yet written in these pages. Reach **rank 2** on a path and defeat the **Vault Guardian** — then return.
chronicler.intro:
*The Chronicler closes his book. The pages are warm.*

"I keep the Journal — the record of every path walked in this world. You walk {paths}; the ink knows your name now. Earn ranks, and the pages will remember you."

*He opens a page you cannot read. On it, a door made of whispers.*

"But there is more. A place the book speaks of — the Hall of Whispers. It opens only to those who master every path of the Journal. They say a legend waits inside. A companion no one else can claim. Ten thousand echoes of glory. And a medallion that weighs nothing and means everything."

*He smiles — or seems to.* "Walk every path, and the Hall will know your name."

journal.rankup: The journal hums. Your standing rises — **rank {rank}** in a path. The Chronicler's quill scratches somewhere in the dark.

ambient.2: *You feel eyes on your back — soft as ink on parchment.*
ambient.3: *Someone has been here. The dust settles in the shape of footprints that stop at the wall.*

recognition.2: *Word travels fast among {path} folk — you have earned their respect.*

recognition.4: *They call you a master of {path}. The Chronicler's ink moves on its own.*
